notes: Man 'Phieu danh gia thang': (1) Dong bo counter theo filter - doi Chi nhanh/Search truoc day chi thay outerHTML cua .phfck-table-wrap, KHONG render lai .phfck-monthly-tabs nen cac so tren tab (Tat ca/Cho tu danh gia/...) dung yen o tong toan ky du bang da loc dung; monthlyRefreshTabsAndTable() gio luon thay ca hai cung luc, dung chung cho ca 3 filter (Phong ban/Chi nhanh/Search). (2) Them filter Phong ban moi (dropdown, nguon current_department tu listMonthly(), AND voi Chi nhanh/Search hien co); doi Phong ban lam Chi nhanh dang chon khong con hop le se tu reset ve 'Tat ca chi nhanh', danh sach Chi nhanh trong dropdown duoc quet lai theo dung Phong ban dang chon (monthlyBranchOptionsForDepartment). (3) Search giờ dung normalizeMatchText (bo dau) thay vi normalizeText - ho tro tim khong dau (vd 'dieu' khop 'Diệu'). (4) exportChecklistMonthlyData nhan them filter department (loc theo current_department, AND voi branch/status/query), giu nguyen ca snapshot (branch/department/title) lan current (currentBranch/currentDepartment/currentTitle) tren moi dong xuat - UI loc dung thi Excel cung loc dung, khong rong hon. Khong doi bang chup snapshot tren checklist_monthly_forms, khong reconcile, khong dung frontend lam hang rao quyen (backend scope qua getChecklistExportAccess/admin() khong doi).
